what_happened: scripts/validators/validate_rich_new_page_contract.js scoped its candidate rows to a HARDCODED run date of 2026-07-03, read them through field names (source_run_id, source_artifacts.manifest) that html-report-contract page_specs do not carry, and treated a missing release artifact as an empty created list. All three defects pointed the same way: it matched zero rows and printed "PASS (0 created page(s))" on every run since it was written. Rescoping it to the latest run date actually present in the sources exposed what the stale date had been covering. Of the 191 rich-authority-required page_specs in artifacts/validation/html-report-contract.json, 171 rows - 136 distinct target_routes, the rest being the same route re-admitted on a later run - name a target_route that exists in neither content/_live/pages.json nor content/_staged/pages.json nor on disk. They were discovered, classified, marked READY_TO_RELEASE and admitted for build, and then never built. The 171 admitted rows span 27 run dates from 2026-06-23 to 2026-08-27; the 136 distinct routes were first admitted on 25 of those dates. The oldest has been waiting since 2026-06-23.
why_it_is_not_cleared_here: The backlog is drained by the release lane, not by this file. scripts/content/build_page_release_queue.js now reads every AWAITING_RELEASE_LANE entry here as a third intake lane, oldest-first by first_admitted_on, and puts it through the unchanged page release law; scripts/velocity_content_release.js then builds whatever survives, up to the governed ceiling of 2 new URLs/day in data/authority_scale/velocity_decision.json. That ceiling was NOT raised: spiking new URLs harms discovery on these properties, so the drain runs at the rate policy already allows and no faster. scripts/content/reconcile_unbuilt_backlog.js deletes an entry once its route is built, so the depth here falls as the lane runs, and scripts/validators/validate_unbuilt_backlog_drain.js hard-fails if the backlog ever again has no consumer.

reason_codes.ADMITTED_FOR_BUILD_NEVER_BUILT: artifacts/validation/html-report-contract.json carries a page_spec for this route with admission_basis HTML_REPORT_CONTRACT_PAGE_TO_BUILD and a rich-authority page type (or a /guides/ or /clusters/ route shape, which requires one), but no page object with this path exists in content/_live/pages.json or content/_staged/pages.json and no HTML is rendered for it on disk. The page was admitted and never built. Resolve by building it through the release lane (npm run release:velocity-content, which respects the 2/day ceiling) - then delete the entry from this file, which the validator requires - or by withdrawing the spec from the contract if the query no longer merits a page.

dispositions.AWAITING_RELEASE_LANE: Still wanted; queued behind the 2 new URLs/day ceiling. Age is legible from first_admitted_on.
